title: The slap stick and Sam Morgan's use of it
summary: Howard describes the slap stick Sam Morgan used to hold the drummer's tempo, his own use of it, and taking it to England; he also mentions the song whistle.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
